race.comment: TICKETY BOO (6) had one run and it was more than adequate at Pakenham. She has had two trials to be ready with some strong gear adjustments to note. Sure to go well. GO MAGGIE MAE (10) will be making her debut and has been very forward in her trial results. Certainly bred to want a little bit of ground. EXPRESS SONIC (7) only had one run in SA and was ok there. Had a trial since, so monitor the betting. DAMA ROYALE (4) showed decent speed at Donald and had contested better maidens. Probably needs to lift a bit but can feature. SMART STEP (9) is an unraced 3yo gelding who has trialled four times. Was impressive when winning trial on June 22 at Cranbourne over 760m. Watch the betting.
